blocks.text:
Meet your English-speaking guide in the hotel lobby after breakfast.

After breakfast, a guided city tour of São Paulo, beginning in the historic centre: Praça da Sé and the Cathedral, Liberdade, home to the largest Japanese community outside Japan, the Pátio do Colégio where the city was founded, the Viaduto do Chá, the Municipal Theatre, the Municipal Market, Praça da República and the Edifício Itália.

The route also passes through the station square and the suburban railway station.

Then explore the modern city: Avenida Paulista and Ibirapuera Park, whose vast grounds are decorated with water channels, lakes and spreading trees, with playgrounds and bike trails. See the Obelisk, built in honour of the heroes of the 1932 Constitutionalist Revolution, and the Monument to the Bandeiras, recalling the colonial expeditions in search of gold and precious stones. The tour ends in the elegant districts with modern architecture and the colourful graffiti district.

The park also has sports areas.
